{07 14 00}Hey, kid!{01 00 00 14 00} I just got the
coolest fossil.

{07 0d 00}I've got it all set up and
lookin' scary in my room,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}. {01 00 00 05 00}Rawwr!

{07 00 00}There's somethin' about my
room and fossils. They just
go together, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 11 00}Your place, though... Not
good for fossils. Just give
'em all to me.

{07 14 00}It's a good thing I've got
a fearsome fossil guarding
my room.
{07 00 00}It scares away all the
annoyingly happy people in
this town.
